mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal contains lean protein and fresh vegetables with a creamy dressing, which may impact blood sugar levels moderately due to the dressing's fat and carbohydrate content. It is best to limit creamy dressings and opt for a vinaigrette or olive oil-based dressing instead to reduce glycemic impact for someone with diabetes. Including more high-fiber vegetables can further support blood sugar control.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A salad composed of grilled chicken breast, romaine lettuce, cucumber, cauliflower, and a creamy dressing, served with a wooden spoon.
